description: Invalid-artifact corpus for the cartridge loader (protocol/cartridge.schema.json DiagnosticCode: stage order, paths and data; 05 §11, §20; CAR-05, CAR-07). Each case is an artifact file as text (its UTF-8 bytes are the input), the installed kernel/app, and the one expected diagnostic, hand-written from the DiagnosticCode text; break names the bug the case catches. Artifacts derive from cartridge_hash.json value (the attribute*, stat_compare_* and resource_compare_* cases from cartridge_road_hash.json value with attributes, the attributes@1 lock or pray's policy root changed; the band_* and move_cost_* cases from cartridge_rooms_hash.json value with condition band tables, band.<key> text and a world move cost added); each canonical text and content_hash was produced by Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) and hashlib.sha256 over its UTF-8 bytes, never by the kernels. The slot_* cases derive from cartridge_wear_hash.json value with equipment@1 left out of requires and the lock, or the lantern's slot made finger. Over-cap and non-UTF-8 inputs are bytes, not text, and live in the test.
